pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: I need to get the screen fixed
paragraphs: Fictional repair: screen quote $80. Original collection estimate Friday 5 pm, before a trip. Fitting and testing are separate stages. A temporary phone has been requested but not promised. Only choose one service in this conversation; other vocabulary items are extensions.

pages.title: A repair before a trip
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I need to get my phone screen fixed before I travel on Friday
lines.audioText: I need to get my phone screen fixed before I travel on Friday.
lines.translation: Preciso consertar a tela do celular antes de viajar na sexta

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The quote is eighty dollars. Collection is planned for Friday at five
lines.audioText: The quote is eighty dollars. Collection is planned for Friday at five.
lines.translation: O orçamento é de oitenta dólares. A retirada está prevista para sexta às cinco

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Is that a confirmed completion time or an estimate?
lines.audioText: Is that a confirmed completion time or an estimate?
lines.translation: Esse é um horário confirmado ou uma estimativa?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: An estimate until we check the replacement part. We’ll confirm tomorrow
lines.audioText: An estimate until we check the replacement part. We’ll confirm tomorrow.
lines.translation: Uma estimativa até conferirmos a peça. Confirmaremos amanhã

questions.prompt: Why does Ana need the screen fixed soon?
How much is the repair quote?
questions.answer: The repair quote is eighty dollars

questions.prompt: Is Friday at five a confirmed collection time?
questions.answer: No, it is an estimate until the replacement part is checked

pages.title: What counts as ready?
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Thanks. I don’t want to assume it’s ready just because the part has arrived
lines.audioText: Thanks. I don’t want to assume it’s ready just because the part has arrived.
lines.translation: Obrigada. Não quero presumir que está pronto só porque a peça chegou

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Of course. First the screen is fitted, then the phone is tested
lines.audioText: Of course. First the screen is fitted, then the phone is tested.
lines.translation: Claro. Primeiro a tela é instalada, depois o celular é testado

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Could you contact me before five if there’s a delay?
lines.audioText: Could you contact me before five if there’s a delay?
lines.translation: Pode entrar em contato antes das cinco se houver atraso?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. We’ll tell you what has been done and what is still pending
lines.audioText: Yes. We’ll tell you what has been done and what is still pending.
lines.translation: Sim. Diremos o que foi feito e o que ainda falta

questions.prompt: Why doesn’t the part arriving mean the phone is ready?
questions.answer: The screen still needs to be fitted and the phone tested

questions.prompt: What contact does Ana request if there is a delay?
questions.answer: Ana asks them to contact her before five
The update should say what has been done and what is still pending

pages.title: A contingency to confirm
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Would you have a temporary phone if I need it for the trip?
lines.audioText: Would you have a temporary phone if I need it for the trip?
lines.translation: Vocês teriam um aparelho temporário se eu precisar para a viagem?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: We can check availability, but I can’t promise one today
lines.audioText: We can check availability, but I can’t promise one today.
lines.translation: Podemos verificar, mas não posso prometer um hoje

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s fine. Please keep the repair deadline and the loan separate in the confirmation
lines.audioText: That’s fine. Please keep the repair deadline and the loan separate in the confirmation.
lines.translation: Tudo bem. Mantenha o prazo do reparo e o empréstimo separados na confirmação

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I will. We’ll confirm both rather than leaving you to guess
lines.audioText: I will. We’ll confirm both rather than leaving you to guess.
lines.translation: Vou manter. Confirmaremos ambos em vez de deixar você adivinhar

questions.prompt: What temporary solution does Ana ask about?
questions.answer: Ana asks about a temporary phone for the trip

questions.prompt: Can the shop promise that solution today?
questions.answer: No, the shop needs to check availability
They should confirm the repair deadline and the temporary phone separately

pages.title: Fitted, but still being tested
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. The new screen has been fitted, but the phone is still being tested. The shop now expects collection on Saturday at five, one day later than planned. They do have a temporary phone available from Friday at four, free of charge, to be returned when you collect yours. That may cover the trip, but you’d need to check that it supports what you need and arrange your own account access. Could you respond to the shop, confirm the revised collection time and ask one relevant question about the temporary phone? The repair quote remains eighty dollars
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. The new screen has been fitted, but the phone is still being tested. The shop now expects collection on Saturday at five, one day later than planned. They do have a temporary phone available from Friday at four, free of charge, to be returned when you collect yours. That may cover the trip, but you’d need to check that it supports what you need and arrange your own account access. Could you respond to the shop, confirm the revised collection time and ask one relevant question about the temporary phone? The repair quote remains eighty dollars.
